2014_spells.enemies-abound.description: You reach into the mind of one creature you can see and force it to make an Intelligence saving throw. A creature automatically succeeds if it's immune to being charmed. On a failed save, the target can't take reactions and must use its action each turn to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose.
2014_spells.enemies-abound.effectSummary: Make a target charmed until it saves or the spell ends
2014_spells.enemies-abound.fullDescripti: Using 1 action, you reach into the mind of one creature you can see and force it to make an Intelligence saving throw. On a failed save, the target can't take reactions and must use its action each turn to make a melee attack against a creature other than itself that you mentally choose; A creature automatically succeeds if it's immune to being charmed. The effect lasts for concentration, up to 1 minute.
